summary: The cliconf plugin is chosen automatically from ansible_network_os and normally shouldn't be overridden. Most need no configuration, and a few expose options. Each plugin documents its own options.
questions: Do I need to set the cliconf plugin manually?
Do cliconf plugins need any configuration?
Where do I find a cliconf plugin's options?

answer_card.title: Using cliconf plugins
answer_card.answer_md: The plugin is selected from `ansible_network_os`, so there's normally no need to override it. Most work without configuration. A few have options that change how tasks become CLI commands, and those are listed in each plugin's own docs.
